pay_cost_of_living_007.answer: 1% for FY 2018; 0.5% for FY 2019. Covered: Teachers’ Unit salary schedule.
pay_cost_of_living_007.evidence: For FY 2018, the new salary schedule for the Teachers’ Unit will be adjusted upward by one percent (1%). For FY 2019, the new salary schedule for the Teachers’ Unit will be adjusted upward by on half percent. (.5%).

pay_extra_duty_schedule_008.answer: Yes. Article XII.F; covers substitution and extra-hour assignment duties.
pay_extra_duty_schedule_008.evidence: If the substitute office is unable to supply a regular substitute whenever the classroom teacher is absent, the District will compensate teachers performing substitution/extra hour assignment duties according to the following guidelines: 1. Substituting for a self-contained elementary teacher’s class shall be paid at the rate of $150.00 per day... 2. Extra hour assignments or substituting during the planning/preparation periods shall be paid at the rate of $25.00 per 45/50-minute period or $50.00 per 90-minute period.
pay_extra_duty_schedule_008.coder_notes: Updated page reference to 35 per Table of Contents. Evidence explicitly confirms supplemental pay rates for substitution and extra-hour assignments.
